symbols.name: butterfly map
symbols.meaning: The two-point map sending a pair (u, v) to ((u+v)/2, (u-v)/2), applied coefficientwise to records.
symbols.quote: The butterfly is the two-point map $H_0$ that replaces a pair of values by their half-sum and half-difference.

symbols.name: first input value
symbols.meaning: The first of the two input values that a butterfly combines.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ be the first input value and $v$ the second, and here these letters do not keep the meanings they have on earlier pages.

symbols.name: second input value
symbols.meaning: The second of the two input values that a butterfly combines.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ be the first input value and $v$ the second, and here these letters do not keep the meanings they have on earlier pages.

symbols.name: bit index
symbols.meaning: The index of the bit a level acts on, counted from 0 at the least significant end.
symbols.quote: Let $\Xi$ be the index of the bit a level acts on, counted from $0$ at the least significant end.

relations.quote: The butterfly is an elementary step of the [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md).
The butterfly is followed by a [Cyclic shift](cyclic-shift.md) of each record.
